inference_boundary: These results show what a student produces when a CAS and an AI assistant are available: four completed antiderivatives with a technique named beside each. They do not show that any individual student executed a technique through to an antiderivative without a calculator or notes, because the declared conditions leave the authorship of those steps open.
why_this_verification: The teacher's intended inference is about each student individually executing a technique without a calculator or notes, and the declared conditions permit exactly the tool that performs that execution, so the attribution has to come from one short observation in the room; the take-home itself already asks for the right thing and stays as it is.

add.item_text:
No calculator, no notes.

Evaluate  ∫ x e^{3x} dx.

Write the completed antiderivative, and name in one phrase the technique you used.
add.variant_rule: May change: the constant in the exponent (e^{3x}, e^{-x}, e^{x/2}), the sign, and the linear factor (x, 2x, x+1) — one fresh form per period. Must stay fixed: a single polynomial-times-exponential integrand that one application of integration by parts carries to a completed antiderivative, with no calculator and no notes. Key changes with the constant: for ∫ x e^{kx} dx the antiderivative is e^{kx}(x/k − 1/k²) + C. Avoid: x² e^{kx} or x e^{x²} — the first forces a second application and the second is a different technique, and either changes what the item observes.
add.conditions: Proctored in class, individual, on paper, no calculator, no notes, closed book. Three minutes at the start of the period, collected before anything else begins.
add.sufficiency_line: The technique is carried through to a completed antiderivative that is correct for the perturbed constant, with the parts assignment visible and the technique named. A dropped constant of integration or a single arithmetic slip is noted but is not the deciding feature; the deciding feature is whether the chosen technique runs to completion unaided.
add.why_this_primitive: Perturb asks for exactly what the claim names — one integrand, one technique executed to an antiderivative — and changing only a parameter makes the form novel across five periods without asking for anything the take-home did not already ask.
